description: This PHP file defines an interface 'ResourceEndpoint' for RESTful API endpoints, specifying methods for CRUD operations and their validation rules within the OrangeHRM Core API v2 module.

classes.name: ResourceEndpoint
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for API resources, including methods for retrieving, updating, deleting resources and obtaining validation rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single resource, may throw exceptions if not found or other errors occur.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a resource, may throw exceptions if not found, forbidden, or errors in normalization.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource, may throw exceptions if not found, forbidden, or not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method.
